strings.name: changelog_1000
strings.value: " <b>Builds 1000-1001:</b> <ul> <li>🎂the milestone 1000th build of Poweramp, celebrating 15 years of continuous development and support <li>default No DVC and No Headroom options for Other output (used for the wired Android Auto connection) <li>improved <a href=settings/headset#follow_pl_exact>Strict Resume/Pause/Stop</a> option<br> <small>Better handling of connections that rapidly send play/pause/stop commands</small> <li>Poweramp suggests disabling Manage App If Unused option if detected<br> <small>As reported by out users, this setting may revoke file access not only after 60 days of inactivity but also after firmware updates, date changes, and other unexpected events</small> <li>bug fixes and stability improvements <li>updated translations </ul> <br> "

strings.name: changelog_1003
strings.value: " <b>Builds 1002-1025:</b> <ul> <li>bug fixes and stability improvements <li>customizable buttons row on the player screen<br> <small><ul> <li>included in 🎁 Feature Pack #1 <li>✅ the top voted feature from the <a href=https://forum.powerampapp.com/ideas/?mode=popular>New Poweramp Features</a> list <li>long press between buttons to enter edit mode or start it <a href=settings/ui_player#edit_player_screen_buttons>from the settings</a> <li>20+ buttons, such as track menu and track actions, cast, audio info, etc. are available <li>the classic centered layout - buttons will try to fit around the centered slot <li>the plain layout - buttons placed in a compact row <li>normal or small button sizes are available <li>one row or two rows <li>buttons can be scrolled <li>buttons and layout settings are independent for portrait and landscape due to the varying available space in these orientations <li><a href=settings/ui_player#sub_aa_buttons_no_gap>Prefer No Gap</a> option <li><a href=settings/ui_player#sub_aa_buttons_no_lp_edit>Do Not Edit On Long Press</a> option </ul></small> <li>new <a href=settings/ui_theme#player_buttons_bg>Player Buttons Background</a> option for the built-in skins <li>the skin option <a href=settings/ui_theme#labels_bg>Label Background</a> doesn't change screen background anymore <li>new <a href=settings/audio_focus#resume_on_focus>Resume On Focus</a> option <li>new <a href=settings/library_lists#stream_name_in_title>Stream Name In Title</a> option <li>new <a href=settings/ui_player#anim_long_labels_in_lists>Animate Long Labels Everywhere</a> option <li>new Dark Skin <a href=settings/ui_player#anim_long_labels_in_lists>Transparent Status Bar</a> option <li>repeat mode improvements <small><ul> <li>✅ another voted feature from the New Poweramp Features list <li>added new Play All Categories mode, which plays all categories and stops <li>added hints to shuffle/repeat popups <li>updated wording for repeat modes/hints </ul></small> <li>AutoEq presets/devices database update<br> <small>17703 presets updated</small> <li>improved album art handling for streams with very long uris <li>workaround for the headset/headunit/BT key presses intercepted and modified by Gemini <li>updated translations </ul> <br> "

strings.name: changelog_102x
strings.value: " <b>Builds 1026-1032:</b> <ul> <li><b>major Audio Engine update:</b> <ul> <li>✅ the top voted feature from the <a href=https://forum.powerampapp.com/ideas/?mode=popular>New Poweramp Features</a> list <li><b>USB Exclusive Driver</b>: direct access to the attached USB DAC bypassing Android audio, supporting PCM 44.1-768kHz, DSD64-1024 DoP/Raw, and hardware volume control <li><b><a href=settings/audio_bit_perfect>Bit Perfect Modes</a></b> - intended for DAPs/USB DACs; supported for Hi-Res, USB Exclusive, and partially AAudio <ul> <li><b><a href=settings/audio_bit_perfect#global_follow_sr>Follow Track</a></b>: dynamically reconfigures to match the track's sample rate <li><b><a href=settings/audio_bit_perfect#global_perfect_bit_perfect>Perfect Bit Perfect</a></b>: disables DSP, gains, and crossfade to send decoded audio (including DSD) directly to the output <li><b><a href=settings/audio_bit_perfect#global_pipeline64>64-bit Pipeline</a></b>: extends internal format to Float64 for bit-lossless processing or increased DSP accuracy <li><b><a href=settings/audio_bit_perfect#global_dsd_remaster>DSD Remastering</a></b>: converts audio to DSD64-1024, with or without PCM-domain DSP (can be combined with Perfect Bit Perfect mode) </ul> </li> <li>Hi-Res Output <b>native/DoP DSD64-1024</b> support</li> <li><b>Dynamic Reconfiguration</b>: quickly reconfigures engine on routing/codec changes instead of full reloading</li> </ul> </li> <li><a href=settings/audio_outputs2>Audio Outputs</a> settings improvements: <ul> <li>simplified settings hierarchy with shortened Device ➔ Options navigation</li> <li>new sample rate, format, DSD, and other advanced options for <b>USB Exclusive</b> and <b>Hi-Res</b> outputs <li>per-output <b>Follow Track</b>, <b>Perfect Bit Perfect</b>, <b>64-bit Pipeline</b>, <b>DSD Remastering</b> options - where supported <li><b>Allowed Sample Rates</b> option which enables/disables specific sample rates for the given output <li><b>Base-Rate Synchronous Scaling</b> option which enables sample rate change within same 44K/48K-base family <li>DSD Remastering <b>Target DSD Sample Rate</b> and <b>Allow 48 kHz-based DSD</b> options <li>USB Exclusive: <b>Volume Type</b> and <b>Synchronize Hardware Volume</b> options; <b>Release USB DAC while paused</b>, <b>Allow DSD DOP</b>, <b>Prefer DSD Raw</b>, <b>Warmup on Startup</b>, <B>Force USB 1.1</b> options <li><a href=settings/audio_outputs_tweaks#usb_activity>Show Poweramp for USB DACs</a> option, allowing future connections without a confirmation dialog <li><b>custom profiles</b> for USB and Bluetooth devices <li>Bluetooth codec sample rate matching <li>new <a href=settings/audio_output_device_opts?device=bt#set_codec_sr>Set BT Codec Parameters</a> option which dynamically changes Codec sample rate/format<br> <small>AAudio (recommended) and Hi-Res Outputs<br> Android 9+<br> Some phones (e.g., Samsungs) may not allow codec sample rate to be switched this way; others (e.g., Xiaomis), may not allow specific formats/sample rates, etc.</small> <li>experimental <a href=settings/audio_output_device_opts?device=bt#shizuku_absvol>Allow DVC via Shizuku</a> option <li>output related <b>Advanced Tweaks</b> moved to Audio Output ➔ Advanced Tweaks </ul> <li>preamp range increased to <b>-24..+24dB</b><br> <small>Helps with bass EQ on DAPs</small> <li><b>FFmpeg</b> updated to <b>8.1.1</b> <li><b>Webm</b> format support <li>new <a href=settings/audio_tweaks#mod_interpolation>Tracker Decoder Interpolation</a> option <li>Wired Headset/AUX is renamed to <b>Wired 3.5/4.4 mm</b> for DAPs <li>more accurate display of DSD rates <li>updated/improved Hi-Res output support for DAPs: <b>A&K, Cayin, iBasso, HiBy, FiiO, Shanling, Sony, Tempotec</b> <li><a href=settings/audio#audio_info>Audio Info</a> dialog is updated for the new Audio Engine features and provides <b>Fidelity</b> and <b>Processing</b> scores <li><b>Limit button</b> is now highlighted when overload is detected <li>new <a href=settings/headset#pause_on_usb_connection>Pause On USB DAC connection</a> option <li>new <b>Grant via Shizuku</b> option to enable volume-key long-press track controls <li>Samsung Flip widgets for cover screens <li>rescan in folder scans just that folder (and subfolders) <li>AutoEQ presets update <li>skin authors now have protection/optional verification for their skins <li>3rd-party skin settings can now be exported to and imported from JSON files<br> <small>To import a json file from a file manager, use Open with.. Poweramp</small> <li>all new features and options of this update are included into the base app and don't require Feature Package purchase. If you enjoy the update, you can always support us by <a href=settings/feature_packages#buy_uber_badges>purchasing Uberpatron badges</a> </ul><br> "

strings.value: " <b>Builds 971-977:</b> <ul> <li>prev./next category actions for <a href=settings/ui_mediaactions>Media Buttons</a> <li>AutoEq presets/devices database update <li>visualization latency is now also applied to lyrics for a better time synchronization <li>new <a href=settings/misc#op_framerate>Apply OP High Framerate</a> option<br> <small>For Oppo/OnePlus/Nothing phone devices</small> <li>added support for Spinorama txt presets importing <li>bug fixes and stability improvements <li>updated translations - huge thanks to all Crowdin translators! </ul> <br> "

strings.name: changelog_978
strings.value: " <b>Also:</b> <ul> <li>cosmetic <a href=settings/feature_packages#buy_uber_badges>Uberpatron badges</a> <li>support for MOD, IT, S3M, XM, MPTM tracker formats via libopenmpt <li>support for xHE-AAC format via device codecs <li>support for the predictive back animation on Android 14+ <li>new <a href=settings/library#reset_stats>Reset Stats</a> option in Info/Tags dialog<br> <li>changes to <a href=settings/ui_theme#alt_layout>Full Cover, Centered</a> skin options - more room for labels <li>new Visualizations/<a href=settings/vis#vis_ignore_touch_faded>Ignore Touch</a> option <li>new <a href=settings/aa_bg#aa_bg_gradient>Background Gradient</a>, <a href=settings/aa_bg#aa_bg_gradient_color>Background Gradient Color</a>, <a href=settings/aa_bg#aa_bg_gradient_for_list>Background Gradient For Lists</a> options <li>new option in header menu/Add to Launcher for all categories <li>new <a href=settings/headset#ignore_bt_sec>Ignore Bluetooth Commands</a> option<br> <small>Helps ignoring unwanted commands from headunits/BT devices immediately after a connection</small> <li>new <a href=settings/headset#bt_ignore_repeat_shuffle>Ignore Repeat/Shuffle</a> option<br> <small>Disables processing for BT Repeat/Shuffle commands</small> <li>Queue is now reloaded immediately for <a href=settings/library_queue#queue_clear_on_add>Always Clear On Add</a> + <a href=settings/library_queue#queue_start>Start Playing Queue</a>: Immediately options <li>settings search history <li>optimizations for very large libraries (e.g. 50k+ tracks) <li>new option <a href=settings/library_shuffle#no_reshuffle_for_large_lists>No Reshuffle For Large Lists</a> <li>AutoEq presets/devices database update <li>new <a href=settings/ui#num_settings_tags>Settings Shortcuts in Main Menu</a> option <li>new <a href=settings/ui_lyrics#lyrics_keep_screen>Keep screen on</a> for the lyrics option <li>hex color support in color dialogs </ul><br> "

strings.name: changelog_978_fp
strings.value: " <b>Builds 978-988:</b> <ul> <li>introducing 🎁 <a href=settings/feature_packages>Feature Packages</a>: <small><ul> <li>the number of big and small features (user requested/voted on Poweramp forum) packed together into low priced in-app purchase <li>a few packages per year <li>new features added to the same package with the each new build <li>new Full Version purchase includes feature package discount <li>this helps with Poweramp app continued development </ul></small> </ul><small><br></small> 🎁 <a href=settings/feature_packages>Feature package #1</a>: <ul> <li>support for multiple items dragging in playlists and Queue<br> <small>Multiple checked items are dragged as a group</small> <li>new <a href=settings/ui_player#line2_click>Line2 Press</a> and <a href=settings/ui_player#line2_click>Line2 Long Press</a> options <li>new <a href=settings/library_lists#hide_unknown_artist>Hide Unknown Artist</a> option<br> <small>Unknown Artist is hidden from track labels in Poweramp UI as possible</small> <li>new <a href=settings/ui#anim_speed>Animations</a> option<br> <small>Navigation animations now can be faster or disabled</small> <li>more features for this package in the next builds </ul> <br> "

strings.name: changelog_989
strings.value: " <b>Builds 989-991:</b> <ul> <li>new <a href=settings/vis#vis_fs_hide_bars>Hide System Bars For Full Screen</a> option<br> <small>🎁 Feature Pack #1</small> <li>new <a href=settings/ui_player#menu_button_long_press>Menu Button Long Press</a> option<br> <small>🎁 Feature Pack #1</small> <li>new cast option: <a href=settings/audio_output_device_opts?device=chromecast&uniqName=com.maxmpz.audioplayer/output.cc#cc_show_meta>Show Meta Information</a> <li>Info/Tags now shows total played count, including playbacks from the count-based or count-sorted categories<br> <small>As previously, the track sorting or standing within such categories is not changed by playback from these</small> <li>added workaround to support DVC on the specific Android 15 firmwares (Pixel 9 series, Samsungs S25) via <a href=settings/audio_dvc#compensate_dvc_vol>Compensate DVC Volume</a> option <li>Poweramp now can indicate inability to detect Absolute Volume<br><small><ul> <li>on some Android 15 devices it's not possible to detect Absolute Volume. Poweramp now assumes Absolute Volume is enabled and disables DVC when <a href=settings/audio_dvc#no_dvc_bt_absvol>No DVC for Bluetooth Absolute Volume</a> option is checked <li>please uncheck this option if you know Absolute Volume is disabled on your device <li>DVC settings page changed to describe the DVC+Absolute Volume functionality better </ul></small> <li>Android 15 restricts access to BT codec information - app won't be always able to show the codec, but still tries to show sample rate/bits <li>Google Cast for Audio (GC4A) 2.0 support </ul> "

strings.name: changelog_989_2
strings.value: <ul> <b>Also:</b> <li>improved reshuffle for the large (>10k) lists <li>improved very large lists (>20k items) scrolling performance <li>improved mod files scanning performance <li>improved FLAC metadata parsing <li>increased number of Sleep timer possible values <li>audio routing detection code revamp<br> <small>Improved Poweramp detection of the complicated routing changes such as between multiple BT devices</small> <li>improved tag handling of the files with the incorrect extensions (such as a mp4 file with the mp3 extension) <li>.oga, flac in .ogg/.oga support <li>fixed Repeat One in CUE <li>other small changes for Android 15 <li>Target SDK updated to 35 <li>simplified Full Version unlocking via in-app purchase for Play<br> <small>Unlocker app continues to be available on Play for those who previously purchased it</small> </ul> <br>

strings.name: changelog_992
strings.value: " <b>Builds 992-996:</b> <ul> <li>Add to Playlist dialog improvements via selectable modes: <small><ul> <li>Add to single playlist – quickly add songs with a single click to one playlist (duplicates are possible if enabled in Settings) <li>Add – add songs to one or multiple playlists (duplicates are possible if enabled)</li> <li>Toggle – applicable to a single song only. Quickly overview if a song is in playlists and toggle the song in and out (no duplicates)</li> <li>Modes are stored per the selection type – for the single or multiple tracks</li> </ul></small> <li>if file access is removed by the user (via (i)->Storage & cache->Clear access) or by Android (via Manage app if unused), Poweramp now keeps the Library entries intact <small><ul> <li>previously, a normal scan removed inaccessible entries from the Library <li>Full Rescan still removes all inaccessible entries from the Library <li>Poweramp now suggests restoring the missing permissions <li>It's recommended to disable Manage app if unused option for Poweramp as it may suddenly remove the access to files, even if the app is actively used (for example, due to some firmware update) </ul></small> <li><a href=settings/ui#settings_font>Bold+ font</a> for Settings <li>implemented Audio Focus <a href=settings/audio_focus#af_short_duck>Duck Volume</a> for the AAudio output <li>improved resuming and pausing after an audio focus change/call for some devices/firmwares <li>improved audio output detection when voice assistant (Gemini) is used <li>improved <a href=settings/headset#resume_on_bt>Resume on Bluetooth</a> for some devices/firmwares <li>new <a href=settings/headset#beep_more>Beep More</a> option <li>improved compatibility with the old 3rd party skins <li>improved sleep timer <li>improved Bluetooth double/triple button presses for some devices/firmwares <li>updated translations </ul> <br> "

strings.name: changelog_997
strings.value: " <b>Builds 997-999:</b> <ul> <li>16kb page size support<br> <small>Google Play requirement</small> <li>battery, CPU usage, app size optimizations <li>Poweramp may now detect remote-submix (for example, Android Auto) as Other output type <li>enabled <a href=settings/audio_output?uniqName=com.maxmpz.audioplayer/output.athd>Hi-Res output</a> for Android 15+ devices <small><ul> <li>useful for the subset of Android 15+ devices which do not support Hi-Res via AAudio <li><a href=settings/audio_output?uniqName=com.maxmpz.audioplayer/output.aa>AAudio output</a> is recommended for the devices where Hi-Res works with AAudio </ul></small> <li>updated WavPack decoder <li>AutoEq presets/devices database update<br> <small>15199 presets updated</small> <li>new <a href=settings/headset#follow_pl_exact>Strict Resume/Pause/Stop</a> option<br> <small>Use for headunits/devices generating stray play/pause/stop key press commands, which are interpreted as undesired playback toggle or double press</small> <li>improved playlist entries resolution<br> <small>Entries now matched against greater range of sub-paths, and just by filename - in playlist parent folder when appropriate</small> <li>bug fixes and stability improvements <li>updated translations </ul> <br> "
